verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a Management API to upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track multiple versions, and deploy them to a dedicated endpoint, where they can run alongside standard model variants. This covers uploading and serving custom weights, but only on private provisioned dedicated endpoints, not the public shared tier. Missing for 10: support for custom models outside dedicated endpoints, any mention of LoRA adapter serving, detail on supported architectures and weight formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.
